headline: EXCLUSIVE: Nvidia, Microsoft And Palantir Are All Exposed — CIO Warns Investors May Be Missing The Real Risk
summary: SEI CIO Nathan Shetty says investors are focused on AI earnings but may be overlooking the bigger risk to Nvidia, Microsoft and Palantir: higher interest rates.

headline: Rackspace Technology Stock Tanks After Cutting 2026 Outlook
